newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy bourse gives new MIB30 composition, March 7.
newsitem.headline: Italy bourse gives new MIB30 composition, March 7.

text.p: The Italian Stock Exchange Council announced on Friday that the new composition of shares in the blue-chip MIB30 index of Italy's top 30 listed companies will be announced after the close of share trading on March 7.
A statement from the Stock Exchange Council said the period September 2 1996 to February 28 1997 would be the reference period used to select the 30 component shares of the new index.

The new composition of the index will be announced on March 7, the number of outstanding shares of each component stock released on March 21, and then the new basket for the calculation of the index adopted on March 24, it added.

Dealers expect that financial holding group Compart, formerly Ferruzzi Finanziaria, may return to the index after its departure at the last revision of the MIB30 in September 1996, while financial servies group Mediolanum may be dropped.
